description: React component for product category dropdown, including category list, filter by price, and search functionalities in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: CategoryList
methods.description: Fetches and displays product categories, navigates to category pages on click.

methods.name: FilterList
methods.description: Provides price filtering options for products, updates product list based on selected price range.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Search input for filtering products by name, manages search state and triggers product fetch.

methods.name: ProductCategoryDropdown
methods.description: Main component combining category list, filter, and search components.
